test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.

If she __had gone to the party__, she could have met Amit.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' No substitution required.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of the** third conditional**, which is used to talk about hypothetical situations in the past.
 
• In a third conditional sentence, the correct form of the verb in the result clause is **"could have"**.
 
• The structure of the third conditional is **"If + past perfect, could have + past participle"**.

Correct sentence: *If she had gone to the party, she **could have met** Amit*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1st Conditional Sentence:**

 
 
• **Structure:** If + Present Simple, will + base verb.
 
• **Example:** If it rains, we will cancel the picnic.
 
• **Usage: **Describes real or possible situations in the future with likely outcomes.
 
 
 
• **2nd Conditional Sentence:**
 
 
• **Structure: **If + Past Simple, would + base verb.
 
• **Example: **If I were an astronaut, I would look at the stars all the time.
 
• **Usage: **Describes unreal or hypothetical situations in the present or future.
